description: ONE standalone empty player portrait panel for Dungeon Matcher enchanted forest, front orthographic native pixel art UI, transparent outside. Canvas 128x256. Tall rectangular vertical woodland shrine frame, frame body about98x220 pixels centered with padding. Sturdy straight 9-pixel-thick timber rails, clear square mortise corner joints about15x15 pixels; centered continuous broad wood grain stripes. Not wobbly twisted root frame. Restrained warm brown bark/plank construction and top-left highlights. Tasteful connected ivy wrapping primarily along OUTER edges, a few broad leaf clusters upper left and lower right with a graceful thin vine down the side, two tiny ivory flowers at most. Generous clean rectangular inner opening with extremely dark green vertical timber recess, distinct from teal forest outside. Use supplied mockup only for the upper-left portrait's quiet timber/leaf identity and mood. Protect clear space for a gem in upper half and a character lower half: DRAW NO CHARACTERS, NO GEMS, NO BANNERS, NO RUNES, NO TEXT, NO HEALTHBARS. No buttons, scenery, mushrooms, lanterns or board. Foliage supports framing and must not fill the panel; leaves only green, no neon. Native shading language from Rattlebones: broad controlled planes, crisp dark outlines, restrained texture, no noise or gradients. 18 purposeful material colors max. Every rail remains straight and continuous with consistent width and connected corners. Whole silhouette including leaves stays inside padded canvas. This is a material/design source for later exact modular corner-and-tiled-rail construction, never a flattened gameplay image.

reference_images.usage: Design/mood authority for ONLY the upper-left wooden player portrait frame: leaf-wrapped timber boundary and dark recessed interior. Exclude all figures, symbols and UI content.
